verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's own natural-language feature is the in-product "Describe your search" panel, which turns a plain-language description into an error search. Its first-party hosted MCP server also lets an external AI assistant manage projects, investigate errors, run BadgerQL and manage dashboards, but the natural-language layer there comes from the user's own assistant, so it is only an indirect route. missing for 10: native natural-language control beyond search (e.g., resolving errors, configuring alerts or deploys by plain-language command in the product), documentation of how well the NL search translation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can search for errors without writing the query yourself. Click the lightbulb icon next to the search box to open the “Describe your search” panel, then describe what you want to find.
